scope: Read-only RO memory core + offline scratch probes. No production fixes, live private journals, credentials, paid/native calls, config/git/source/cache migration effects.

conformance_rows.detail: Raw journal has lifetime flock, private no-follow file opens, flush/fsync before local append; baseline receipts exercise storage failures.
Facade collapses all whitespace before persistence, so historical originals cannot be recovered from normalized notes.
RO records typed observed experiences, not user/unii/tool/echo/work/note full chat; observed-note equivalence must remain explicitly adapted.
One persona JSONL rather than daily chat streams; indices are list positions, not serialized permanent message ids.
Typed journal has no reasoning field, but a complete model-output logging boundary is absent; cannot prove no thought text enters arbitrary notes.
No full-chat admission/splitting adapter in these ports; neither 30000-character tool cap nor lossless long non-tool chunking is implemented here.
Builds fully covered leaves and exact sibling parents once using per-level counters; no raw-block hybrid or recomputation.
Optional summary store preserves built nodes with acknowledgement-before-publication; no claim that configuration always enables it.
Every short leaf and pair invokes summarizer; counting probe made 3 calls for two short leaves.
Stub joins with tilde; cache rejects newline/control chars. Future short-pair policy requires a new storage encoding, not just a renderer change.
Default limits are 120/200 Python characters and cache accepts up to 4096 bytes; core has no 512-byte policy. The 487-byte free leaf is truncated.
Every rendered line reads a built node summary, including last leaf; docstring calling latest verbatim does not mean a raw-text special case.
View drops oldest covered nodes instead of coarsening; seven-note budget250 probe retains only [6,7). Raw journal is not deleted.
Production uses greedy refit, not due rank (neither first nor last formula). Independent oracle verifies required last-based rank for 20001 steps; do not misattribute old-first implementation to RO.
No incremental sibling selection seam; full summaries built synchronously before refit. Required tie/readiness behavior is separately verified in independent oracle, not production.
Four-to-five note append changes L1:0 prefix to L2:0 even at budget128000, well below pressure.
Every read recomputes a minimal cover under character cap4000; no high/low state or batch boundary.
No pending-batch flag, no parent-ready stall retention; budget enforcement evicts oldest coverage.
Stores raw notes and tree nodes only; there is no view-state store or view checkpoint. Restart reconstructs cover on read, not saved coordinates.
511 emoji notes render 4193 UTF-8 bytes despite budget4000; len(str) is not bytes.
Optional now renders relative age; wall clock30 to200 rewrites the same single-note view. Default now=None does not erase that unsafe API.
Llevel:index names are convertible losslessly, but literal id+n wire format and zoom(id,n) API are absent.
Level-zero zoom returns unchanged summary, not whole original; truncation is irrecoverable through current zoom API.
Timestamp tail helper exists, but no public permanent-message date(id) tool.

No ready queue; existing per-level counters avoid rescanning built nodes, so do not call core tree build O(N²). However repeated full raw-prefix hashing per node is O(N²) work in summary-cache binding.
Synchronous build under RLock; no eight-job worker/admission policy. Parent dependencies are correctly satisfied by bottom-up order, but literal scheduling unavailable.
Summarizer port gets only A/B, no contextual view; neither compacted A/B view state nor missing-built-prefix stop can be supplied.

Qwen prompt has no 512-dash ruler, byte feedback, five-attempt conversation, shortest-line selection, or explicit per-message retry queue. Definition permits slight overshoot after retries:512 is a target for model output, not an unconditional rejection bound.
Core Summarizer/ChatGenerator do not expose tools/system/cache block identity; no provider call executed, therefore no prefix-cache compliance assertion.
RO event-driven decisions and chat escalation are not the literal endless-chat harness; adapting observed experience memory does not establish fresh full-chat continuity.
Provider wire/runtime constraint: no Anthropic request serialization, shared-prefix in-flight coordination, TTL or usage-field verification audited or called.
Optional full-chat feature has no core typed experience analogue; no literal subagent log/zoom(Name) certification.
Decision payload silently slices memory_lines[:40]. Increasing core budget alone would still discard most rendered context at this consumer.
Cache rejects world/persona/policy mismatch, changed/truncated raw prefix, duplicates/noncontiguous levels or missing child closure; existing baseline exercises guards.
Explicit 8192-node and other resource ceilings are safe finite admission, not endless-chat capacity; exceeding them blocks persistence rather than allowing unbounded growth.
Uncertain raw/cache writes poison future work; retains stronger existing safety contract while adapting policy.
Host still defaults deterministic StubSummarizer; optional Qwen is separate from named Haiku policy. No paid or native inference effects.

not_run: full repository gate on moving writers
prototype persistent-view batch/restart tests: design handoff only

handoff.title: Choose adapted policy before effects
requirements: Confirm actual decision/chat model context budget, provider wire, hosted-vs-local compactor economics, concurrency and memory ceiling. Choose explicit adapted RO UTF-8 high/low thresholds; 4000 characters cannot be renamed 64000/128000 bytes.
Declare observed-note adaptation versus complete UniiChat transcript; no new live journal, profile, migration, model, package, or server action without approval.

handoff.title: One finite core/cache-loss repair slice
requirements: Introduce immutable coordinate ViewState + ViewStateStore port (coordinates, pending batch, exact policy/identity, raw count/digest and referenced-node closure); update view only on append/build events, never refit on reads/restart.

Use inclusive-last due rank exact rational comparison, oldest ties, sibling-only merges with built parents; append a leaf otherwise, cross HIGH then coarsen to LOW; stalled pending batches retain full coverage and resume on next message.
Measure rendered payload including separators/provenance in UTF-8; freeze age/date out of cached view; keep timestamps accessible through a separate date API.

Add <=512-byte direct leaves and newline-joined short pairs without inference; new policy storage must preserve newline text, flatten only rendering. Add provider target-size ruler/retries later through an extended port rather than silent character slicing.
Expose real leaf/raw zoom (adapted L names can retain legacy facade wrappers); keep raw append durable before visibility, fail-closed guards, immutable nodes and existing cleanup/poison behavior.

Change decisions memory_lines[:40] only with reviewed consumer byte policy; otherwise core budget fix cannot preserve the full downstream view. Audit context_selector.fit_budget call sites separately: selected retrieval can be intentionally bounded, not whole-history continuity.

handoff.title: Explicit compatible namespace and offline migration design
requirements: Keep old append-only raw/summary files untouched and accepted ADRs immutable. New codec/policy namespace is required; old summaries, raw-normalized notes and absent view checkpoints cannot pretend to preserve the old literal prompt prefix.

Existing typed notes can be imported as adapted note data with original stored text and timestamps, not invented lost whitespace/full-chat kinds. Prior already-normalized originals and never-logged messages cannot be reconstructed.
If old policy lacks persisted view, require explicit one-time baseline reset/bootstrap migration approval; quantify cache invalidation, do not silently refit or claim resume equivalence.

Reject malformed/missing new checkpoint, wrong persona/world/policy, wrong raw prefix or missing referenced nodes/children; source binding incremental hash/checkpoint design must remove quadratic repeated prefix work without weakening integrity.

Maintain legacy Memory.remember/view/zoom_line signatures only as documented adapters; new ViewState, raw leaf/date retrieval and compactor-context/scheduling ports need exact compatibility tests. World root supplied explicitly; never infer unknown profile/model labels.

handoff.title: MVP acceptance cutoff
requirements: Offline TDD on unchanged-safety fixtures: append prefix under no pressure, 511-emoji bytes, no dropped coverage, immutable node content, T10 and 20001-step rank oracle, oldest ties, delayed parent pending batches, corrupt/missing checkpoint rejection, exact restart view and raw-prefix/child closure validation.
Run scoped and completed-snapshot whole quality gates only after writers stop; no automatic implementation from this audit.

Separate later contextual compactor 16000/32000-byte view, bounded ready queues/admission, five-attempt 512-byte feedback, fresh literal full-chat logging, and provider-specific stable system/tools/cache wire metrics. Real Anthropic marks/usage and live effects remain unverified, not waived by pure oracle success.

issues: First stdlib urllib public API fetch failed TLS certificate validation; curl with normal certificate checks retrieved and verified authoritative current content. web.run also could not access GitHub URLs.

Legacy tests intentionally encode old policy: ASCII character-budget checks, newest leaf preference, age suffix and leaf zoom no-op; 139 passes are legacy safety evidence, not current-definition compliance.
